Fixes:
* can't let java thread wait on control_lock (TODO: need to avoid spurious wakeups from old mark increments)
* escalate to global gc if allocation failures happen during concurrent mark (previously we'd have run a young degenerated cycle).
* narrow the scope of gc_mode when servicing old to previous erroneous cancellations during other gc cycles and phases

Controller tweaks:
* loop back to service loop after finishing bootstrap to check for requests before starting mark
* mutators need to be able to cancel old mark threads when an allocation fails, they shouldn't have to wait for old marking to finish
* always clear heap cancellation reason when starting a request. It is now always set under a lock so we are less concerned about 'losing' the request now
